tips.campaignWins: Raid the 3-energy Indomitus nodes (6 to 14) first; raids count as wins. Aim to reach mission 19 in week 1.
tips.campaignRaids: Raid the 3-energy Indomitus nodes (6 to 14) first, then the 5-energy ones from 15.
tips.arenaBattles: Save 7 to 8 Arena tokens before day 1 so missions 4, 10 and 15 clear quickly.
tips.guildRaids: Keep 2 Guild Raid tokens for mission 8.
tips.onslaught: Keep an Onslaught token for mission 12.
tips.salvageRuns: Keep 2 Salvage Run tokens for mission 7.
tips.lightningVictories: Raids on a running campaign event's nodes count as lightning victories.
tips.killEnemies: Use area-of-effect units on easy campaign nodes.
tips.killWithMelee: Use melee units with area attacks on easy campaign nodes.
tips.killWithRanged: Use ranged units with many hits on easy campaign nodes.
tips.killWithAlliance: Use area-of-effect units of the event's alliance on easy nodes.
tips.killFaction: Replay early campaign nodes where this faction is the enemy.
tips.damage: Arena and Onslaught battles deal lots of damage quickly.
tips.abilityDamage: Use units whose active abilities hit several enemies.
tips.damageType: Field units that deal this damage type and use their abilities every turn.
tips.featuredDamage: Use the featured hero in Arena and Onslaught.
tips.useAbilities: Easy campaign nodes let you use every ability each battle.
tips.useAbilitiesAlliance: Field a team of the event's alliance and use every ability each battle.
tips.useAbilitiesFeatured: Bring the featured hero and use their active ability every battle.
tips.heal: Bring a healer or repairer to easy campaign nodes.
tips.winWithoutSummons: Leave summoners out of the team.
tips.winWithAllianceLineup: Use your strongest team of the event's alliance on easy nodes.
